chain.title: A Needle For Places
chain.desc: Amethyst shard and gold. The Wayfinder points at a location and reports the distance, and it is the reagent the Locate Structure ritual consumes.

chain.title: Asking The World Where Things Are
chain.desc: Wayfinder, purple archwood log, a source gem and a compass. This ritual finds any structure by id, which is how you reach an Arcane Library without wandering.

chain.title: A Page From Someone Else's Book
chain.desc: Found only in Arcane Library, Nexus Tower and ruined-portal chests. Reading one teaches a random glyph of its tier - the only glyph source in the ecosystem that is not a Scribes Table recipe.

chain.title: Light That Costs Source
chain.desc: Source gem, iron ingot and nuggets. Magelight lanterns glow without a flame and are the mod's signature decorative build.

chain.title: Lit From The Quarry
chain.desc: Ars Nouveau's sourcestone with a torch and iron nuggets. Ars Additions gives sourcestone the full block family the base mod never bothered with.

chain.title: Walking On Magebloom
chain.desc: A magebloom block cut into carpet. Small, but it is the piece every Ars build wants and never had.

chain.title: Experience In A Bottle
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: allow scroll, furnace, cobblestone, coal and lapis. It stores experience and pours it back, which makes an enchanting setup portable.

chain.title: A Bag That Is Bigger Inside
chain.desc: Ender pearl, gold, purple wool and string. Ars Nouveau never shipped a backpack; this is it.

chain.title: Linking At Range
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: Dominion Wand, amethyst block and gold. It links automation blocks across a far greater distance than the base wand allows.

chain.title: Source Across Dimensions
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: a Source Jar, an ender pearl and popped chorus fruit. Every ender source jar shares one pool, which is how you power a build in the Nether from an Overworld flower farm.

chain.title: Seeing In The Dark, Passively
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: glass bottle, lantern and torch. Charms are Curios items that spend stored source to keep an effect running - fourteen exist and they are the mod's real content.

chain.title: The Fall That Does Not Land
chain.desc: Glass bottle, feather and phantom membrane. It consumes source on impact rather than health.

chain.title: One More Chance
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: crying obsidian, glowstone and a Totem of Undying. A totem you do not have to hold in your hand.

chain.title: The Apparatus That Works Alone
chain.desc: Sneak-use a Wixie Charm on an Enchanting Apparatus. The wixie then runs apparatus recipes for you, which is the closest Ars Nouveau gets to autocrafting.

chain.title: A Spawner You Built
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: conjuration essence, a Drygmy Charm and a Summon Focus. It spawns a captured mob on source, feeding a drygmy farm without a vanilla spawner.

chain.title: Something Still Moving Inside
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: conjuration essence, manipulation essence, a Mob Jar and an ender pearl. It holds a captured entity for the rituals below.

chain.title: Marking A Spot
chain.desc: Glyph recipe: manipulation essence, a Mob Jar, the Containment ritual tablet and an ender pearl. Mark stores a position that Recall returns to.

chain.title: Coming Back
chain.desc: Glyph recipe: conjuration essence, an Enchanter's Eye, a Scryer Scroll and an ender pearl. Recall is the return half of the Mark pair and the cheapest teleport in the ecosystem.

chain.title: A Spell With Its Own Mana
chain.desc: Scribe a spell into a parchment and pour source into it. Holding use gathers the stored source - about half a second per hundred mana - and casts without touching your own pool.

chain.title: Filing Your Destinations
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: Bookwyrm Charm, Enchanter's Eye, Mundane Belt, Scryer's Crystal and a Starbuncle Charm. Five Ars Nouveau curios spent at once to build a warp directory.

chain.title: Warping Without Losing Anything
chain.desc: Warp Index, an ender chest, a nether star and netherite. The stabilized version survives dimension changes and is this mod's true endgame item.

chain.title: The Waystone In The Tower
chain.desc: Warp Nexuses are placed inside Nexus Tower structures, standing on a source leyline so they teleport for free. Move one and it costs a thousand source per jump.

chain.title: The Scroll Inside The Nexus
chain.desc: Every Nexus Tower's warp nexus is generated holding one, bound to that tower's location. Nine of them fit inside a single nexus.

chain.title: Keeping The Lights On
chain.desc: Blue archwood log, earth essence, a source gem and a nether star. Arcane Permanence keeps a chunk ticking, which is what a source-powered farm needs to run while you are away.

notes: 62 ids resolve as assets/ars_additions/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys; the three glyphs (mark, recall, retaliate) are verified the extra way - item model plus a data/ars_additions/recipes entry of type ars_nouveau:glyph - because Ars Nouveau glyphs have no item. lang key. Ordering read from data/ars_additions/recipes/apparatus/*.json (ars_nouveau:enchanting_apparatus) and the bundled Patchouli pages in the lang file. OBTAIN PATHS THAT ARE NOT RECIPES, all verified in the jar: codex_entry appears in data/ars_additions/loot_tables/chests/{arcane_library,nexus_tower,ruined_portal}.json; warp_nexus and nexus_warp_scroll are placed by data/ars_additions/worldgen/processor_list/{arcane_library,nexus_tower}.json; enchanting_wixie_cauldron is made by sneak-using a Wixie Charm on an Enchanting Apparatus (its block loot table drops a plain ars_nouveau:enchanting_apparatus back); imbued_spell_parchment is produced by a scribing action. DROPPED DELIBERATELY: ars_additions:ancient_codex_entry and ars_additions:lost_codex_entry are registered (they appear in data/minecraft/tags/items/bookshelf_books.json) but have NO recipe, NO loot-table entry and NO structure placement anywhere in the jar, so they would make uncompletable tasks. The four structures are arcane_library, nexus_tower, ruined_portal and ruined_portal_large. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: ars_nouveau:worn_notebook, an Enchanting Apparatus with arcane pedestals, ars_nouveau:source_jar, ars_nouveau:sourcestone, ars_nouveau:magebloom_block, ars_nouveau:dominion_wand, ars_nouveau:mob_jar, ars_nouveau:ritual_containment, ars_nouveau:scryer_scroll, ars_nouveau:enchanters_eye, ars_nouveau:bookwyrm_charm, ars_nouveau:starbuncle_charm, ars_nouveau:drygmy_charm, ars_nouveau:wixie_charm, ars_nouveau:mundane_belt, Curios.
